title: plugin-email: the localized organization invitation mails (zh-CN / ja-JP / es-ES) print the raw role value — 「邀请您以 member 的身份加入」 — where the English mail reads the same enum as a word
body: Filing gate ①: a measured defect with a named site. Filed by `repo:cloud` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the cloud#2435 dev's out-of-scope finding (its report on cloud#2435, comment 6230381891; PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2969). ⛔ Not a claim; no assignee. Grading is triage's. **Reader who acts:** the lane that owns `packages/plugins/plugin-email` (the `auth.invitation` templates), one dev round. **Dedupe:** semantic search of this repository's issues for the invitation mail's role wording, `auth.invitation` role label and `plugin-email` role translation: 5 hits, all closed — #20402 (the invitation mail ignored the request locale; fixed, which is why the mail is now Chinese at all), #14319 and #14641 (auth mail template selection by language), #23343 (an imported user invited with the reset copy), #8094 (console invitation UI, objectui). None names the role value inside the localized copy. ## What happens (measured on the real `apps/cloud` signup chain at cloud `c8a8409`, framework pin `be076dad28a0`) A zh-CN workspace (creation seed zh-CN, no report yet) invites an unregistered address; the inviter's request is `Accept-Language: en-US`. - subject: `Workspace Owner 邀请您加入 Acme Workspace` — Chinese, as #20402 intended; - text body: `Workspace Owner（…）邀请您加入 ObjectOS Cloud 上的 Acme Workspace。 接受邀请：…` — Chinese, and it does not name the role; - HTML body: Chinese apart from one raw value: `邀请您以 member 的身份加入 ObjectOS Cloud 上的 Acme Workspace`. **Site** (read in the pin tree, `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/templates/auth-templates.ts`): the `auth.invitation` templates interpolate `{{role}}` verbatim — the English at line 346 (`as {{role}}`), zh-CN at line 371 (`以 {{role}} 的身份加入`), ja-JP at line 387 (`{{role}} として参加`), es-ES at line 403 (`como {{role}}`). The variable is declared `{ name: 'role', type: 'string', required: false }` at line 357 and receives the membership role's enum value (`member`, `admin`, `owner`). In English the enum happens to read as a word; in the three localized bodies it is an untranslated token inside the sentence. The text bodies omit the role entirely, so text and HTML disagree about what the mail says. ## Wanted One of the two, decided by the lane that owns the template (the seat recommends the first, the structural one): 1. The invitation sender passes the role's **label in the mail's locale** (the same option label the console shows for the membership role), and the templates keep interpolating one variable; or 2. the localized HTML bodies drop the role clause the way their text bodies already do, so the four bodies say the same thing. Done when a zh-CN invitation's HTML body, rendered on the real chain or through the template's own test, carries no raw enum value, and the text and HTML bodies name the same facts. ## Evidence - The reading above is from the cloud#2435 dev's report (comment 6230381891 on objectstack-ai/cloud#2435, section "Item 6: the invitation mail, measured"); the seat re-read the template lines in the pin tree and did not re-run the chain. - Dedupe words: invitation mail raw role, auth.invitation role label, 以 member 的身份加入, plugin-email role translation.
